messages:
maya: heads up — customer 'ClearLens' on Dedicated eu-west-1 reporting intermittent 403s for API calls that used to work. started after we flipped LB TLS offload for them. error pattern looks like valid JWT sometimes, other times 403 with 'missing scope'.

jordan: any chance we dropped Authorization header at the LB? envoy+istio path?

maya: that was my first thought. but when we tcpdump we sometimes see both: cookie (signed_session) + Authorization: Bearer <token>. other times only cookie. weird part: requests with both still 403. stack trace points to our ext_authz service returning OK but the downstream service rejecting (scope mismatch).

samir: could be authz precedence — ext_authz returns a principal derived from cookie and not from the Authorization header, so downstream enforcer sees a session user with limited scopes.

maya: that matches local repro. when both present, our ext_authz picks cookie over header (legacy support) and validates cookie lookup in redis. cookie user is low-priv. header token would have been fine.

edge-proxy-bot: collected headers for sample request id 0a3f:
```
:authority: api.clearlens.prod
:method: POST
:scheme: https
authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...
cookie: signed_session=eyJzaWdu...
content-type: application/json
```

oncall-rita: is the LB rewriting or normalizing header names? some LBs collapse duplicate header names and keep last seen. if the LB buffers chunked body or healthchecks, header ordering could flip.

ops-bob: also check max header size/truncation. if cookie is huge, Authorization might be truncated at NGINX or the envoy filter. we've seen truncated bearer before => 401-ish though.

jordan: quick repro steps i ran:
1) curl with both cookie and Authorization set -> 403 in prod ALB cfg.
2) curl removing cookie -> 200.
3) curl removing auth header -> 403 (expected).

maya: exact. so toggling cookie changes outcome. we need to decide whether ext_authz should prefer Authorization over cookie for Dedicated tenants using SSO.

samir: patch idea: change auth flow to prefer explicit Authorization header if present. small safe change: in ext_authz handler, if http.authorization exists, validate it first; only fallback to cookie if header missing.

ops-bob: low-risk but must be canaried — some customers rely on cookie-first behavior for web UI traffic. Dedicated API customers expect header-first. we can gate by route: if path starts with /api/ then header-first.

maya: canary plan: add config flag in ext_authz + envoy filter that flips precedence for routes matching /v1/* and set rollout to 5% on Dedicated pools. add logging to count header vs cookie auth for 24h.

oncall-rita: also need to confirm LB doesn't strip X-Forwarded-Authorization or rename Authorization to X-Auth. I saw a config where AWS ALB rewrites Authorization to authorization (lowercase) and our istio filter was case-sensitive (bad).

jordan: yep, we had a bug where the istio ext_authz HTTP header match used exact-case. Envoy normalizes headers to lowercase but some middleware upstream didn't. add header normalize step: `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;` for nginx-ingress or `--preserve-host`?

samir: sample envoy ext_authz config snippet we used in the fix:
```
http_filters:
- name: envoy.filters.http.ext_authz
  typed_config:
    '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ext_authz.v3.ExtAuthz
    grpc_service: { ... }
    failure_mode_allow: false
    include_request_headers_in_check: ["authorization", "cookie"]
```

maya: thanks. i'm going to:
- push route-level header-precedence flag to canary (5%) for clearlens dedicated pool
- add logging metric auth_precedence{route,choice} and a quick dashboard
- run curl-based smoke tests from multiple regions to catch LB header rewrites

ops-bob: also add a short-term mitigation: if ext_authz sees both cookie+auth header and cookie's principal is low-priv, return a 401 (instead of 200) so downstream can prompt for reauth. That avoids silent downgrade.

oncall-rita: note for runbook: if customer reports same, gather: full raw request headers (via capture script), LB config (TLS offload on/off), envoy listener config, cookie size, and sample token introspection response.

maya: will do. creating a ticket to track: RT#2024-7893 (internal). linking PR when ready. I'm also going to ping @security for signoff on precedence change (:lock:).

jordan: +1 from me for route-based precedence. keep UI/web routes cookie-first. API routes header-first.

samir: i can review ext_authz patch today. also will add unit tests to verify precedence behavior and a perf check for the extra token introspection.

maya: thanks team. interim action: notify ClearLens support engineer to instruct client to remove signed_session cookie for API calls as a short-term workaround.

ops-bob: reaction: :thumbsup:

edge-proxy-bot: capture logs uploaded to s3://redwood-dumps/clearlens/1748503210/ (files: headers-0a3f.log, tcpdump-0a3f.pcap)

maya: closing loop later after canary metrics. will update thread.
